Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original editorial photographic detail for an explicitly labeled dental website concept, not documentation of an actual clinic.
Shared art direction: refined clinical still-life photography, cool silver and pale neutral gray palette, soft large studio daylight from upper left, gentle natural shadow, crisp stainless steel reflections, realistic small surface imperfections, quiet and humane, no warm beige, no saturated blue, no CGI/plastic render look. Seamless pale gray studio background. Medium format photographic detail, neutral color grading. No text, brand, badge, logos, watermarks, blood, syringes, mouths, faces, full teeth rows, braces or real clinic interiors. Full believable professional objects, no impossible anatomy or floating tool parts.
Subject/composition: one adult hand in a very pale blue-gray nitrile glove gently holding ONE slim stainless-steel dental mirror. Correct professional precision grip, natural five-finger anatomy with some fingers naturally hidden, wrist entering from lower left. Long slender polished handle angles gently up toward upper right. The small circular mirror head is fully visible around upper third, facing slightly toward the viewer and reflecting only soft studio light, no teeth or face. Entire mirror and gloved fingers are within frame, with generous clear margin above and either side for responsive cropping. Portrait 4:5 composition, hand occupies lower third, tool provides elegant vertical line, quiet negative space around the upper mirror. Sharp polished metal and realistic matte glove texture. This is an independent original photograph, do not imitate a specific existing image.
